coverage: Targeted diagram review of the bound associativity isomorphism at statement lines 26–40 and its proof, checking the tensor-product domains, balancing relations, inverse, outer actions, and naturality.

findings.evidence: The source is a right R-module M, an (R,S)-bimodule N, and a left S-module P. The map has domain (M⊗_R N)⊗_S P and codomain M⊗_R(N⊗_S P), and sends ((m⊗n)⊗p) to m⊗(n⊗p). These are groups with the stated tensor products; the canonical map is an isomorphism of groups.

On the target, the R-relation mr⊗(n⊗p)=m⊗((rn)⊗p) is respected by the source R-relation (mr⊗n)⊗p=m⊗(rn⊗p). The S-relation ((m⊗n)s)⊗p=(m⊗n)⊗sp maps to m⊗((ns)⊗p)=m⊗(n⊗sp). The inverse is β(m⊗(n⊗p))=((m⊗n)⊗p); its R- and S-balancing checks are the reverse equalities. Both composites fix elementary tensors, which generate the tensor products, so α and β are inverse.

If M also has a compatible left A-action and P a compatible right B-action, both commuting with the R- and S-actions used in the balances, then A and B act on both iterated tensor products at the outer ends. The formulas α(a·((m⊗n)⊗p))=am⊗(n⊗p)=a·α((m⊗n)⊗p) and α(((m⊗n)⊗p)·b)=m⊗(n⊗pb)=α((m⊗n)⊗p)·b show α is an (A,B)-bimodule map; β has the same compatibility. For compatible module maps f:M→M′, g:N→N′, h:P→P′, both paths in the naturality square agree on ((m⊗n)⊗p), hence on all elements.
No group cosets or double cosets occur in this module-theoretic construction, so no representative or indexing convention is needed.

A concise reassociation picture can make the two iterated tensor-product objects and the canonical generator map immediately visible. The proof already supplies the balancing checks, inverse, and naturality in text, so a diagram is optional and its added value is an editorial judgment.

Both listed local PNGs were viewed at original resolution. The first shows the statement and most of the proof; the second shows the proof's closing lines. The receipt reports zero KaTeX errors, zero TikZ diagrams, and zero diagram failures.

recommendation: A small reassociation diagram with the correctly typed associator and inverse is a sound optional illustration. Keep its editorial value uncertain; the absence of art alone is not a mathematical or rendering defect.
